name: Surface Smoothness Regularization
aliases: Surface Smoothness on Integrated Unobserved Rays
definition: A regularization technique that imposes surface smoothness constraints on rendered depth from unobserved rays (unseen and hidden rays) to alleviate spatial ambiguity and stabilize joint optimization of blur kernel and radiance fields in sparse view DeRF.
summary: Surface Smoothness Regularization stabilizes sparse-view DeRF optimization by imposing geometric constraints on depth from integrated hidden and unseen rays, distinguishing itself by targeting coupled deblurring and reconstruction.
